# BoseUI — LLM & AI Assistant Documentation Index

> Kinetic React Components Engineered to Make Interfaces Feel Alive
> Crafted by Rishabh Bose (https://theb0se.vercel.app/)

## Overview
- **Library**: BoseUI
- **Website**: https://boseui.site
- **Author**: Rishabh Bose — GitHub: https://github.com/Theb0se | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/rishabhbose3107/
- **Stack**: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- **Registry Index**: https://boseui.site/registry.json

## Available Kinetic Components (150)

### AI Chat Bubble (`AIChatBubble`)
- **Slug**: `ai-chat-bubble`
- **Category**: Cards
- **Tagline**: Physics spring-entrance chat bubble for AI conversation UIs.
- **Description**: Spring-entrance chat message bubble for AI interfaces. Supports user (right, filled) and assistant (left, outlined) roles, animated typing dots state, optional avatar initials, and timestamp.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/ai-chat-bubble
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/ai-chat-bubble.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/ai-chat-bubble.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Spring entrance animation: y:16→0 + opacity fade.
  - Role-aware layout: user right-aligned filled, assistant left outlined.
  - Typing dots variant with staggered bounce animation.
  - Optional avatar initials and timestamp.
  - prefers-reduced-motion: static render without animation.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Text content fully accessible to screen readers.
  - No motion when prefers-reduced-motion is set.
- **Props**:
  - `role` ("user" | "assistant"): Controls bubble alignment and color scheme.
  - `content` (string): Message text content.
  - `typing` (boolean, default: false): Show animated typing dots instead of content.
  - `avatar` (string): Optional avatar initials or emoji.
  - `timestamp` (string): Optional timestamp string shown below content.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { AIChatBubble } from "@/components/ui/ai-chat-bubble";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 p-4 max-w-md">
      <AIChatBubble role="user" content="How do I center a div?" avatar="U" />
      <AIChatBubble role="assistant" typing />
      <AIChatBubble
        role="assistant"
        content="Use flexbox: display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;"
        avatar="AI"
        timestamp="Just now"
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

---

### AI Command Bar (`AICommandBar`)
- **Slug**: `ai-command-bar`
- **Category**: Navigation
- **Tagline**: Slash-command AI bar with spring suggestions panel and keyboard nav.
- **Description**: Slash-command aware AI input bar inspired by Linear and Raycast. Type / to reveal a spring-animated suggestions panel with keyboard navigation, staggered item entrance, and a shimmer idle border.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/ai-command-bar
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/ai-command-bar.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/ai-command-bar.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Type / to trigger animated suggestions panel with spring AnimatePresence.
  - Staggered item entrance animation per suggestion row.
  - Full keyboard navigation: Arrow keys to move, Enter to select, Escape to dismiss.
  - layoutId spring highlight slides smoothly between hovered items.
  - Rotating conic-gradient shimmer on border in idle state.
  - Fully configurable commands array.
- **Accessibility**:
  - role='combobox' on input with aria-expanded and aria-autocomplete.
  - role='listbox' + role='option' on suggestions panel.
  - Keyboard-only navigation support.
- **Props**:
  - `commands` (AICommand[]): Array of slash commands with trigger, label, description.
  - `onSelect` ((command: AICommand) => void): Called when a command is selected.
  - `placeholder` (string, default: "Type / for AI commands…"): Input placeholder text.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { AICommandBar } from "@/components/ui/ai-command-bar";

const commands = [
  { id: "summarize", trigger: "summarize", label: "Summarize", description: "Summarize selected text" },
  { id: "explain", trigger: "explain", label: "Explain", description: "Explain this concept" },
];

export function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xl mx-auto">
      <AICommandBar
        commands={commands}
        onSelect={(cmd) => console.log("Selected:", cmd.label)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

---

### AI Generation Progress (`AIGenerationProgress`)
- **Slug**: `ai-generation-progress`
- **Category**: Motion
- **Tagline**: Spring-physics ring progress for AI generation with token counter.
- **Description**: Spring-animated SVG ring progress indicator for AI token generation. Shows determinate progress with a rolling token counter, or an indeterminate spin when total is unknown.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/ai-generation-progress
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/ai-generation-progress.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/ai-generation-progress.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Spring-animated stroke-dashoffset for smooth arc fill on progress changes.
  - Indeterminate spinning arc when total token count is unknown.
  - Center displays current/total tokens or percentage.
  - Configurable size and stroke width.
  - Accessible with role=progressbar and aria attributes.
- **Accessibility**:
  - role='progressbar' with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax.
  - aria-label for screen reader identification.
- **Props**:
  - `progress` (number, default: 0): Progress 0–100. Ignored in indeterminate mode.
  - `current` (number): Current token count shown in ring center.
  - `total` (number): Total token count shown in ring center.
  - `indeterminate` (boolean, default: false): Spin indeterminately when total is unknown.
  - `size` (number, default: 96): Ring diameter in pixels.
  - `strokeWidth` (number, default: 5): Ring stroke width in pixels.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { AIGenerationProgress } from "@/components/ui/ai-generation-progress";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-6">
      <AIGenerationProgress progress={65} current={325} total={500} />
      <AIGenerationProgress indeterminate />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### AI Prompt Input (`AIPromptInput`)
- **Slug**: `ai-prompt-input`
- **Category**: Inputs
- **Tagline**: Auto-expanding AI prompt field with spring-morphing submit button.
- **Description**: Auto-expanding AI textarea with a morphing submit button that transitions between arrow, spinner, and check states using spring physics. Includes character counter with color warnings and ⌘↵ keyboard shortcut.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/ai-prompt-input
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/ai-prompt-input.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/ai-prompt-input.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Auto-resizes vertically as content grows (max 180px).
  - Submit button morphs: arrow → spinner → check with spring AnimatePresence.
  - Character counter appears on first keystroke with color warnings near limit.
  - ⌘↵ keyboard shortcut to submit.
  - External loading state prop for async submit flows.
  - prefers-reduced-motion: no button morph animation.
- **Accessibility**:
  - aria-label on textarea and submit button.
  - aria-multiline='true' on textarea.
  - Disabled state on submit button when empty or loading.
- **Props**:
  - `placeholder` (string, default: "Ask anything…"): Textarea placeholder text.
  - `maxLength` (number, default: 500): Maximum character count.
  - `onSubmit` ((value: string) => void): Called with trimmed text when submitted.
  - `loading` (boolean, default: false): External loading state — shows spinner and blocks submit.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { AIPromptInput } from "@/components/ui/ai-prompt-input";

export function Example() {
  async function handleSubmit(text: string) {
    console.log("Submitting:", text);
  }

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xl mx-auto">
      <AIPromptInput
        placeholder="Ask me anything…"
        maxLength={400}
        onSubmit={handleSubmit}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

---

### AI Status Badge (`AIStatusBadge`)
- **Slug**: `ai-status-badge`
- **Category**: Motion
- **Tagline**: Animated AI state pill with spring transitions and beacon pulse.
- **Description**: Live AI presence pill that communicates real-time processing state — Idle, Thinking, Generating, Done, or Error. Each state transitions with spring animation and a pulsing beacon dot.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/ai-status-badge
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/ai-status-badge.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/ai-status-badge.json
- **Key Features**:
  - 5 states: idle, thinking, generating, done, error — each with distinct color.
  - AnimatePresence spring morph between label text on state change.
  - Pulsing beacon dot for active states (thinking, generating).
  - CSS variable colors — works in dark and light mode automatically.
  - prefers-reduced-motion: static badge without pulse or transitions.
- **Accessibility**:
  - role='status' + aria-label announces state to screen readers.
  - Color is never the sole differentiator — label text always present.
- **Props**:
  - `status` ("idle" | "thinking" | "generating" | "done" | "error"): Current AI processing state.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { AIStatusBadge } from "@/components/ui/ai-status-badge";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
      <AIStatusBadge status="idle" />
      <AIStatusBadge status="thinking" />
      <AIStatusBadge status="generating" />
      <AIStatusBadge status="done" />
      <AIStatusBadge status="error" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### AI Streaming Text (`AIStreamingText`)
- **Slug**: `ai-streaming-text`
- **Category**: Text
- **Tagline**: Render AI responses character-by-character with a live cursor.
- **Description**: Character-by-character text renderer that simulates real-time AI token streaming, complete with a physics-spring blinking cursor that vanishes when generation completes.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/ai-streaming-text
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/ai-streaming-text.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/ai-streaming-text.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Configurable streaming speed per character in milliseconds.
  - Blinking pipe cursor with AnimatePresence fade-out on completion.
  - prefers-reduced-motion: instantly reveals full text.
  - onComplete callback for chaining responses or UI transitions.
  - Auto-restarts animation when text prop changes.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Uses inline span — preserves semantics for screen readers.
  - Full text visible immediately for reduced-motion users.
- **Props**:
  - `text` (string): The full text to stream.
  - `speed` (number, default: 28): Milliseconds per character.
  - `showCursor` (boolean, default: true): Show blinking cursor while streaming.
  - `cursorChar` (string, default: "|"): Character to use as cursor.
  - `onComplete` (() => void): Called when streaming finishes.
  - `autoRestart` (boolean, default: true): Restart animation when text prop changes.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { AIStreamingText } from "@/components/ui/ai-streaming-text";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <p className="text-lg font-medium">
      <AIStreamingText
        text="Here's how I can help you build beautiful interfaces."
        speed={30}
        onComplete={() => console.log("Done!")}
      />
    </p>
  );
}
```

### AI Thinking Loader (`AIThinkingLoader`)
- **Slug**: `ai-thinking-loader`
- **Category**: Motion
- **Tagline**: Spring-physics AI thinking indicator with dots, wave, and ring variants.
- **Description**: Physics-grade animated loading indicator that communicates AI processing states. Three spring-animated orbs in dots, wave, or ring variants — far richer than plain CSS keyframe spinners.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/ai-thinking-loader
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/ai-thinking-loader.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/ai-thinking-loader.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Three variants: dots (scale pulse), wave (vertical oscillation), ring (arc spinner).
  - Staggered spring physics per dot for natural organic feel.
  - prefers-reduced-motion: static rendering.
  - Fully accessible with role=status and aria-label.
  - Configurable dot size and custom aria label.
- **Accessibility**:
  - role='status' + aria-label for screen reader announcement.
  - Static rendering when reduced motion is preferred.
- **Props**:
  - `variant` ("dots" | "wave" | "ring", default: "dots"): Animation style variant.
  - `size` (number, default: 8): Orb diameter in pixels.
  - `label` (string, default: "AI is thinking…"): Accessible status label.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { AIThinkingLoader } from "@/components/ui/ai-thinking-loader";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
      <AIThinkingLoader variant="dots" />
      <AIThinkingLoader variant="wave" size={10} />
      <AIThinkingLoader variant="ring" size={6} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Accordion (`Accordion`)
- **Slug**: `accordion`
- **Category**: Navigation
- **Tagline**: Animated collapsible panels with single or multi-expand support.
- **Description**: Smooth collapsible disclosure panels with spring-rotated chevron indicators, single or multiple expansion modes, and full keyboard accessibility.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/accordion
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/accordion.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/accordion.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Smooth height and opacity transitions powered by Framer Motion AnimatePresence.
  - Supports both single-open and allowMultiple expansion modes.
  - Optional monospace subtitle badges for each accordion header.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Uses semantic <button> headers with aria-expanded state announcements.
  - Full Enter and Space keyboard support for toggling panels.
  - Respects prefers-reduced-motion automatically.
- **Props**:
  - `items` (AccordionItem[]): Array of accordion items with id, title, optional subtitle, and content.
  - `allowMultiple` (boolean, default: false): When true, multiple panels can remain open at the same time.
  - `defaultOpenIds` (string[], default: ["item-1"]): Array of item IDs expanded on initial render.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { Accordion } from "@/components/ui/accordion";

export function Example() {
  return <Accordion allowMultiple={false} />;
}
```

### Accordion Stack Cards (`AccordionStackCards`)
- **Slug**: `accordion-stack-cards`
- **Category**: Cards
- **Tagline**: Spatial 3D card deck with hover cascade and spring cycling.
- **Description**: Spatial 3D card deck that fans out into a vertical cascade on pointer hover or focus and cycles card order with spring layout projection.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/accordion-stack-cards
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/accordion-stack-cards.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/accordion-stack-cards.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Depth-scaled 3D card stack that smoothly fans out into an inspectable vertical cascade on hover or keyboard focus.
  - Click or press Enter/Space on any card to cycle the front card to the back with Hooke's Law layout springs.
  - Zero external dependencies beyond Framer Motion and Lucide icons.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Each card is keyboard-focusable and automatically expands the stack when focused via Tab.
  - Supports Enter and Space keys to cycle cards through the deck.
  - Disables scale depth transformations when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.
- **Props**:
  - `items` (StackCardItem[]): Array of card items containing id, badge, title, metric, and subtitle.
  - `stiffness` (number, default: 300): Spring stiffness coefficient for deck expansion and card cycling.
  - `damping` (number, default: 25): Spring damping coefficient controlling stack oscillation decay.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { AccordionStackCards } from "@/components/ui/accordion-stack-cards";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <AccordionStackCards stiffness={300} damping={25} />
  );
}
```

### Animated Tabs (`AnimatedTabs`)
- **Slug**: `animated-tabs`
- **Category**: Navigation
- **Tagline**: Sliding pill tabs built with Framer Motion layoutId springs.
- **Description**: Smooth shared-element sliding pill tabs with animated panel transitions, optional badge counters, and keyboard arrow navigation.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/animated-tabs
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/animated-tabs.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/animated-tabs.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Shared-element active pill indicator powered by Framer Motion layoutId.
  - Crossfades tab panel content smoothly on selection change.
  - Supports badge counts and Left/Right arrow keyboard navigation.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Implements WAI-ARIA role='tablist', role='tab', and role='tabpanel'.
  - Supports Left and Right arrow keys to switch between tabs.
  - Respects prefers-reduced-motion automatically.
- **Props**:
  - `tabs` (TabItem[]): Array of tab items containing id, label, optional badge, and content.
  - `defaultTabId` (string): ID of the tab selected on initial render.
  - `onChange` ((tabId: string) => void): Callback fired when the user switches tabs.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { AnimatedTabs } from "@/components/ui/animated-tabs";

export function Example() {
  return <AnimatedTabs />;
}
```

### Context Menu & Popover (`AppleContextMenu`)
- **Slug**: `apple-context-menu`
- **Category**: Overlays
- **Tagline**: Blurred popover menu with arrow caret and destructive actions.
- **Description**: Frosted glassmorphic context menu and popover with a directional pointer arrow, hairline-divided action groups, keyboard shortcuts, and red destructive items.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/apple-context-menu
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/apple-context-menu.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/apple-context-menu.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Frosted `backdrop-blur-xl` panel with a diamond-rotated top pointer arrow.
  - Supports both left-click button trigger and right-click context menu activation.
  - Hairline-divided action groups with dedicated red styling for destructive actions.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Uses `role='menu'` and `role='menuitem'` with `aria-haspopup='menu'` and `aria-expanded`.
  - Dismisses automatically on `Escape` key press or outside pointer click.
  - Respects `prefers-reduced-motion` for menu scale transitions.
- **Props**:
  - `groups` (ContextMenuGroup[]): Array of action groups separated by hairline dividers.
  - `triggerLabel` (string, default: "Actions Menu"): Label displayed inside the menu trigger button.
  - `defaultOpen` (boolean, default: false): Initial open state when rendered.
  - `onSelect` ((item: ContextMenuItem) => void): Callback fired when any menu item is clicked.
  - `className` (string): Additional Tailwind CSS classes for the wrapper.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { AppleContextMenu } from "@/components/ui/apple-context-menu";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <AppleContextMenu
      triggerLabel="Actions Menu"
      onSelect={(item) => console.log("Selected:", item.label)}
    />
  );
}
```

### Search Field (`AppleSearchField`)
- **Slug**: `apple-search-field`
- **Category**: Inputs
- **Tagline**: Rounded search bar with sliding Cancel button and quick chips.
- **Description**: Rounded iOS-inspired search bar with a magnifier icon, inline clear badge, quick suggestion pills, and a 'Cancel' button that slides in smoothly on focus.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/apple-search-field
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/apple-search-field.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/apple-search-field.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Shared-layout spring compression on the input bar as the 'Cancel' button slides in from the right.
  - Animated circular clear (`X`) button that appears as soon as the user types.
  - Reveals filterable quick-suggestion pills while focused.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Uses semantic `type='search'` with `Escape` key bound to clear and dismiss focus.
  - Includes explicit `aria-label` on the clear button.
  - Respects `prefers-reduced-motion` for layout and slide transitions.
- **Props**:
  - `placeholder` (string, default: "Search components, tokens, or docs..."): Placeholder text shown inside the search bar.
  - `value` (string): Controlled search query value.
  - `defaultValue` (string, default: ""): Initial search query for uncontrolled mode.
  - `onChange` ((query: string) => void): Callback fired whenever the search query changes.
  - `onCancel` (() => void): Callback fired when the Cancel button or Escape key is pressed.
  - `suggestions` (string[]): Quick suggestion chips displayed below the field when active.
  - `className` (string): Additional Tailwind CSS classes for the outer wrapper.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { AppleSearchField } from "@/components/ui/apple-search-field";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <AppleSearchField
      placeholder="Search components..."
      onChange={(q) => console.log("Query:", q)}
    />
  );
}
```

### Asteroid Field (`AsteroidField`)
- **Slug**: `asteroid-field`
- **Category**: Backgrounds
- **Tagline**: Three-layer parallax planetesimals with live meteor showers.
- **Description**: Deep-space parallax asteroid field and meteor shower on Canvas 2D featuring procedural faceted rock polygons across three depth layers, crater shading, ambient dust motes, and high-speed bolide meteors.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/asteroid-field
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/asteroid-field.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/asteroid-field.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Procedurally generated faceted polygon rocks with directional solar shading and surface craters
  - Three distinct parallax depth planes (far, mid, near) rotating and drifting at realistic relative speeds
  - High-speed glowing bolide meteors with linear gradient plasma tails
  - Three mineral composition palettes: Basalt, Kuiper Ice, and Ferrous Iron
- **Accessibility**:
  - Decorative canvas is marked aria-hidden so screen readers focus on foreground content
  - Velocity slider allows slowing or pausing orbital drift for motion-sensitive users
- **Props**:
  - `asteroidCount` (number, default: 32): Total number of procedural faceted asteroids across the 3 depth layers.
  - `speed` (number, default: 1.0): Parallax drift velocity multiplier.
  - `angle` (number, default: 18): Drift trajectory angle in degrees.
  - `meteorFrequency` (number, default: 0.4): Spawn probability multiplier for high-speed glowing meteors.
  - `colorTheme` ("basalt" | "ice" | "iron", default: "basalt"): Mineral color palette applied to asteroids, craters, and meteors.
  - `children` (React.ReactNode): Optional foreground UI rendered above the asteroid field.
  - `className` (string): Additional CSS classes for the root container.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { AsteroidField } from "@/components/ui/AsteroidField";

export function AsteroidFieldDemo() {
  return (
    <AsteroidField
      asteroidCount={32}
      speed={1.0}
      angle={18}
      meteorFrequency={0.4}
      colorTheme="basalt"
    />
  );
}
```

### Atmospheric Fog (`AtmosphericFog`)
- **Slug**: `atmospheric-fog`
- **Category**: Backgrounds
- **Tagline**: Volumetric domain-warped mist layers drifting across twilight.
- **Description**: Volumetric drifting fog and mist banks powered by a custom WebGL domain-warped FBM shader with multi-layer parallax across a moody moonlit depth gradient.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/atmospheric-fog
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/atmospheric-fog.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/atmospheric-fog.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Real-time WebGL fragment shader using nested domain-warped Fractional Brownian Motion (FBM)
  - Configurable multi-octave parallax mist layers moving at independent horizon speeds
  - Subtle pointer parting displacement that gently parts the mist around the cursor
  - Live HUD presets for Moonlit Slate, Nordic Pine, Crimson Dusk, and Golden Dawn palettes
- **Accessibility**:
  - Low-frequency, smooth motion prevents visual fatigue andvestibular strain
  - All HUD controls are keyboard accessible and non-intrusive when custom children are supplied
- **Props**:
  - `density` (number, default: 0.7): Controls the opacity and volumetric thickness of the mist layers.
  - `speed` (number, default: 1.0): Multiplier for horizontal drift and internal domain-warp evolution speed.
  - `fogColor` (string, default: "#CBD5E1"): Hex color for the illuminated mist banks and moonlit scattering.
  - `backgroundColor` (string, default: "#090D16"): Hex color for the deep twilight zenith sky gradient.
  - `layers` (number, default: 4): Number of parallax mist banks stacked from foreground to background (1 to 6).
  - `children` (React.ReactNode): Optional foreground UI rendered above the WebGL fog canvas.
  - `className` (string): Additional Tailwind CSS classes for the root container.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { AtmosphericFog } from "@/components/ui/AtmosphericFog";

export default function AtmosphericFogDemo() {
  return (
    <AtmosphericFog
      density={0.75}

      fogColor="#CBD5E1"
      backgroundColor="#090D16"
      layers={4}
    >
      <div className="flex min-h-[520px] flex-col items-center justify-center p-8 text-center">
        <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white">
          Silent Valley
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-3 max-w-md text-slate-300">
          Multi-layered volumetric mist powered by domain-warped FBM noise.
        </p>
      </div>
    </AtmosphericFog>
  );
}
```

### Autocomplete (`Autocomplete`)
- **Slug**: `autocomplete`
- **Category**: Inputs
- **Tagline**: Searchable combobox input with grouped results and keyboard navigation.
- **Description**: Customizable search combobox with instant filtering, grouped categories, keyboard navigation, and spring-animated dropdown results.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/autocomplete
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/autocomplete.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/autocomplete.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Real-time filtering across labels, values, descriptions, and categories.
  - Full ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Enter, and Escape keyboard navigation with auto-scroll.
  - Supports grouped option categories, descriptions, and one-click clear.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Implements ARIA combobox, listbox, and option roles with unique aria-controls ID.
  - Supports full keyboard operation without requiring a mouse.
  - Respects prefers-reduced-motion for dropdown open/close transitions.
- **Props**:
  - `options` (AutocompleteOption[], default: DEFAULT_OPTIONS): Array of options with value, label, optional description, icon, and category.
  - `value` (string): Controlled selected option value.
  - `defaultValue` (string, default: ""): Initial selected value when used as an uncontrolled component.
  - `onChange` ((value: string, option: AutocompleteOption | null) => void): Callback triggered whenever the user selects or clears an option.
  - `label` (string): Optional visible label rendered above the combobox.
  - `placeholder` (string, default: "Search options..."): Placeholder text shown when no option is selected.
  - `emptyMessage` (string, default: "No matching results found."): Message displayed when no options match the search query.
  - `clearable` (boolean, default: true): Displays a clear button when an option is selected.
  - `disabled` (boolean, default: false): Disables user interaction with the combobox.
  - `className` (string): Additional CSS classes applied to the outer wrapper.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { Autocomplete } from "@/components/ui/autocomplete";

const FRAMEWORKS = [
  { value: "nextjs", label: "Next.js", category: "Fullstack", description: "App Router & Server Actions" },
  { value: "remix", label: "Remix", category: "Fullstack", description: "Web standards router" },
  { value: "vite", label: "Vite", category: "Build Tools", description: "Next-gen frontend tooling" },
];

export function Example() {
  return (
    <Autocomplete
      label="Framework"
      placeholder="Select a framework..."
      options={FRAMEWORKS}
      defaultValue="nextjs"
    />
  );
}
```

### Black Hole (`BlackHole`)
- **Slug**: `black-hole`
- **Category**: Backgrounds
- **Tagline**: WebGL relativistic accretion disk with geodesic light bending.

  - Real-time WebGL geodesic light-bending ray marcher around a Schwarzschild/Kerr event horizon
  - True 3D tilted accretion disk with multi-octave FBM spiraling plasma filaments and bent upper/lower gravitational lensing arches
  - Relativistic Doppler beaming that shifts the approaching disk toward incandescent white-gold and the receding side toward deep amber-crimson
  - Gravitationally lensed background starfield and razor-sharp incandescent photon sphere ring

  - `diskColor` (string, default: "#FF7A18"): Primary hex color of the glowing accretion disk and lensing halo.
  - `spinSpeed` (number, default: 1.2): Angular velocity and relativistic Doppler beaming multiplier for orbiting matter.
  - `particleCount` (number, default: 260): Filament resolution scale in the relativistic accretion disk.
  - `pull` (number, default: 0.35): Radial inward gravitational pull and spacetime curvature strength.
  - `lensing` (boolean, default: true): Whether to enable full relativistic gravitational light bending.
  - `children` (React.ReactNode): Optional foreground content rendered above the black hole canvas.

```tsx
      lensing
    />
```

### Cipher Scramble Text (`CipherScrambleText`)
- **Slug**: `cipher-scramble-text`
- **Category**: Text
- **Tagline**: Cryptographic glyph permutation wave with screen-reader safety.
- **Description**: Cryptographic matrix text decoder that permutes characters through a high-frequency glyph wave on pointer hover, focus, or click.

- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/cipher-scramble-text.json`

- **Key Features**:
  - Progressive left-to-right cryptographic character lock-in with customizable glyph pool and frame cadence.
  - Triggers seamlessly on pointer hover, keyboard focus, or tactile click.
  - Pairs an sr-only canonical string with an aria-hidden visual stream so screen readers never read scrambled noise.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Exposes the decoded canonical string inside an sr-only node while marking the permuting glyph stream aria-hidden='true'.
  - Fully keyboard-triggerable via Tab focus or Enter/Space activation.
  - Bypasses character scrambling immediately when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.
- **Props**:
  - `text` (string, default: "ZERO-DEPENDENCY KINETIC PRIMITIVES"): Target decoded text string.
  - `charset` (string, default: "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789#$%&*+<>?"): Pool of cipher characters sampled during scramble frames.
  - `frameInterval` (number, default: 28): Duration of each scramble frame tick in milliseconds.
  - `cyclesPerChar` (number, default: 2): Number of scramble ticks per character before locking into place.
- **Usage Example**:

```tsx
  return (
    <CipherScrambleText
      text="ZERO-DEPENDENCY KINETIC PRIMITIVES"
      frameInterval={28}
      cyclesPerChar={2}
    />
  );
```

- **Slug**: `color-finish-picker`
- **Category**: Inputs
- **Tagline**: Apple-inspired titanium finish selector with concentric rings and ambient tinting.
- **Description**: Apple-style device finish selector featuring concentric selection rings, synchronized ambient page background tinting, crossfading vector hardware graphics, and technical metallurgy specifications.

- **Key Features**:
  - Concentric selection rings with smooth Apple-style scale and offset animations.
  - Dynamic ambient page background tinting synchronized with selected finish hex.
  - Smooth crossfading vector hardware preview across multiple view angles (rear, profile, camera).
  - Comprehensive technical metallurgy specs panel with alloy, coating, and optical reflectance metrics.
  - Fully keyboard accessible with ARIA selection attributes.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Each color swatch acts as an accessible radio/button element with descriptive `aria-label`.
  - Keyboard focus indicators preserve high contrast regardless of dark/light theme.
  - Respects reduced motion preferences for smooth crossfade transitions.

  - `defaultFinishId` (string, default: "natural-titanium"): Identifier of the finish selected by default on mount.
  - `onChange` ((finish: ColorFinish) => void): Callback invoked whenever user selects a new color finish.
  - `className` (string): Additional Tailwind CSS classes applied to the root container.
  - `showHeader` (boolean): Whether to display the header title and titanium finish spec label
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { ColorFinishPicker } from "@/components/ui/ColorFinishPicker";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <ColorFinishPicker
      defaultFinishId="natural-titanium"
      onChange={(finish) => console.log("Selected finish:", finish.name)}
    />
  );
}
```

### Command Menu (`CommandMenu`)
- **Slug**: `command-menu`
- **Category**: Navigation
- **Tagline**: Cmd+K command palette with grouped actions and instant search.
- **Description**: Spotlight-style Cmd+K command palette portaled above the viewport with grouped actions, live keyword filtering, and full keyboard navigation.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/command-menu
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/command-menu.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/command-menu.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Portaled to document.body at z-[9999] so it always renders above navbars and page layouts.
  - Global Cmd+K / Ctrl+K shortcut listener plus customizable search trigger button.
  - Grouped command sections with keyword search, ArrowUp/ArrowDown navigation, and auto-scroll.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Renders with role='dialog' and aria-modal='true' with automatic search input focus.
  - Supports full keyboard operation (ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Enter, Escape).
  - Locks background page scroll while open and respects prefers-reduced-motion.
- **Props**:
  - `items` (CommandItem[]): Array of command items ({ id, label, group, shortcut, keywords, icon, onSelect }).
  - `placeholder` (string, default: "Type a command or search..."): Placeholder text inside the command search input.
  - `triggerLabel` (string, default: "Search commands..."): Label displayed inside the trigger button.
  - `enableGlobalShortcut` (boolean, default: true): Listens for global Cmd+K / Ctrl+K keyboard shortcut when true.
  - `open` (boolean): Controlled open state for the command menu dialog.
  - `onOpenChange` ((open: boolean) => void): Callback fired when the command menu opens or closes.
  - `onSelect` ((item: CommandItem) => void): Callback fired when a command item is executed.
  - `emptyMessage` (string, default: "No matching commands found."): Message displayed when no commands match the search query.
  - `className` (string): Additional Tailwind CSS classes for the trigger wrapper.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { CommandMenu } from "@/components/ui/command-menu";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <CommandMenu
      triggerLabel="Quick commands..."
      onSelect={(item) => console.log("Executed:", item.label)}
    />
  );
}
```

### Constellation Map (`ConstellationMap`)
- **Slug**: `constellation-map`
- **Category**: Backgrounds
- **Tagline**: Precision J2000.0 celestial star chart with animated constellation vectors.
- **Description**: Astronomical SVG star chart plotting authentic geometries for Orion, Cassiopeia, Ursa Major, Cygnus, and Lyra over a celestial Right Ascension and Declination coordinate grid with animated stroke-dashoffset line tracing.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/constellation-map
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/constellation-map.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/constellation-map.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Authentic stellar coordinates and Bayer designations for Orion, Cassiopeia, Ursa Major, Cygnus, and Lyra.
  - Staggered SVG pathLength vector animation over a toggleable Right Ascension / Declination grid.
  - Interactive star nodes displaying apparent visual magnitude and Bayer designation telemetry on hover.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Semantic SVG chart includes an aria-label while background field stars are marked aria-hidden='true'.
  - Interactive HUD toggles support full keyboard navigation and clear active state indicators.
- **Props**:
  - `lineColor` (string, default: "#38BDF8"): Stroke color for constellation edges and celestial grid lines.
  - `starColor` (string, default: "#F8FAFC"): Fill color for primary constellation star nodes and field stars.
  - `drawSpeed` (number, default: 1.0): Speed multiplier for the constellation line-drawing animation.
  - `showGrid` (boolean, default: true): Renders Right Ascension meridians, Declination parallels, and the ecliptic arc.
  - `showLabels` (boolean, default: true): Displays constellation headers, Bayer designations, and star names.
  - `children` (React.ReactNode): Optional foreground overlay content.
  - `className` (string): Additional Tailwind CSS classes for the container.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { ConstellationMap } from "@/components/ui/ConstellationMap";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <ConstellationMap
      lineColor="#38BDF8"
      starColor="#F8FAFC"
      drawSpeed={1.2}
      showGrid
      showLabels
    />
  );
}
```

### Copy Code Block (`CopyCodeBlock`)
- **Slug**: `copy-code-block`
- **Category**: Cards
- **Tagline**: Multi-tab CLI command and code block with instant copy feedback.
- **Description**: Multi-tab CLI and code snippet block with sliding spring package-manager tabs (npx, pnpm, bun, yarn), optional line numbers, and one-click clipboard copy feedback.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/copy-code-block
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/copy-code-block.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/copy-code-block.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Spring-animated tab pill indicator for switching between npx, pnpm, bun, and yarn or multiple files.
  - One-click clipboard copy button with animated Check/Copy icon transition.
  - Supports single-line CLI prompts ($) as well as multi-line code blocks with line numbers.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Uses native button elements with focus-visible rings for tab switching and clipboard copy.
  - Provides explicit aria-label on the clipboard button.
  - Respects prefers-reduced-motion for tab indicator transitions.
- **Props**:
  - `tabs` (CodeSnippetTab[]): Array of tabs ({ id, label, code, language }) displayed in the header bar.
  - `code` (string): Optional single code string when multiple tabs are not needed.
  - `title` (string, default: "Terminal"): Header label used when a single `code` prop is provided.
  - `showLineNumbers` (boolean, default: false): Displays line numbers next to multi-line code snippets.
  - `showPromptPrefix` (boolean, default: true): Displays a `$` terminal prefix before single-line commands.
  - `onCopy` ((copiedText: string) => void): Callback fired when the active snippet is copied.
  - `className` (string): Additional Tailwind CSS classes for the outer card.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { CopyCodeBlock } from "@/components/ui/copy-code-block";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <CopyCodeBlock
      tabs={[
        { id: "npx", label: "npx", code: "npx shadcn@latest add button" },
        { id: "pnpm", label: "pnpm", code: "pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add button" },
        { id: "bun", label: "bun", code: "bunx shadcn@latest add button" },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

### Cursor Follower (`CursorFollower`)
- **Slug**: `cursor-follower`
- **Category**: Motion
- **Tagline**: Coupled dual-spring pointer follower with declarative HUD labels.
- **Description**: Dual-spring custom pointer stage with a high-stiffness inner core and morphing outer ring that expands into contextual HUD pills.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/cursor-follower
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/cursor-follower.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/cursor-follower.json
- **Key Features**:
  - High-stiffness inner core dot paired with a damped trailing outer ring.
  - Declarative contextual label morphing via the data-cursor-label HTML attribute.
  - Built-in live X/Y coordinate telemetry HUD in the stage corner.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Automatically restores native OS pointer and hides custom follower rings when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.
  - Follower layers use pointer-events-none so underlying buttons and links remain 100% clickable.
  - Decorative follower elements are hidden from screen readers via aria-hidden='true'.
- **Props**:
  - `accentColor` (string, default: undefined): Optional hex or CSS color override applied to the inner core dot and trailing ring border.
  - `ringStiffness` (number, default: 260): Spring stiffness of the trailing outer ring.
  - `ringDamping` (number, default: 22): Spring damping of the trailing outer ring.
  - `ringSize` (number, default: 34): Idle diameter in pixels of the outer ring.
  - `showCoordinates` (boolean, default: true): Displays a live X/Y coordinate telemetry badge in the top-right corner.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { CursorFollower } from "@/components/ui/cursor-follower";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <CursorFollower className="p-8">
      <div data-cursor-label="OPEN PROJECT ↗" className="rounded-xl border p-6">
        Hover me to morph the trailing cursor ring into a HUD pill.
      </div>
    </CursorFollower>
  );
}
```

### macOS Dock Magnification (`DockMagnification`)
- **Slug**: `dock-magnification`
- **Category**: Navigation
- **Tagline**: Fluid macOS dock magnification with spring physics and launch bounce.
- **Description**: macOS-inspired dock magnification bar with continuous Gaussian/cosine pointer falloff, spring physics scaling, click-to-bounce launch animations, floating tooltip labels, and running indicator dots.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/dock-magnification
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/dock-magnification.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/dock-magnification.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Continuous Gaussian/cosine pointer falloff calculating dynamic icon sizing smoothly in real-time.
  - Spring-damped physics eliminating jarring jumps during rapid pointer movement.
  - Click-to-bounce keyframe oscillation simulating macOS application launch feedback.
  - Frosted backdrop glass container with specular reflections and dark/light mode elegance.
  - Customizable magnification factor, falloff radius, and app running indicator dots.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Keyboard accessible with tab navigation and focus indicators on dock apps.
  - Clear ARIA labels for each application icon with tooltips for screen readers.
  - Respects reduced motion settings for bounce oscillations and scale effects.
- **Props**:
  - `items` (DockAppItem[]): Array of dock application objects with icons, colors, running states, and badges.
  - `baseSize` (number, default: 48): Default unmagnified icon size in pixels.
  - `magnification` (number, default: 1.65): Peak magnification multiplier when cursor directly hovers an item.
  - `distance` (number, default: 140): Gaussian falloff influence radius in pixels on either side of pointer.
  - `onItemClick` ((item: DockAppItem) => void): Callback triggered when a dock icon is clicked.
  - `className` (string): Additional Tailwind CSS classes applied to root container.
  - `embedded` (boolean): Whether the dock renders embedded inside container rather than fixed to viewport
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { DockMagnification } from "@/components/ui/DockMagnification";

  return (
    <DockMagnification
      magnification={1.7}
      distance={150}
      onItemClick={(app) => console.log("Launched:", app.name)}
    />
  );
}
```

### Drawer (`Drawer`)
- **Slug**: `drawer`
- **Category**: Overlays
- **Tagline**: Multi-directional slide-over panel and draggable bottom sheet.
- **Description**: Slide-over panel and bottom sheet drawer with 4-direction support, drag-to-dismiss gestures, top-level portal rendering, and Escape dismissal.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/drawer
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/drawer.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/drawer.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Renders in a top-level document.body portal (z-9999) above all navbars and containers.
  - Slides from right, left, bottom, or top with directional drag-to-dismiss gestures.
  - Works both controlled (open/onOpenChange) and uncontrolled with custom triggers.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Renders with role='dialog' and aria-modal='true' and locks background scroll while open.
  - Closes immediately when pressing the Escape key or clicking the backdrop.
  - Collapses slide motion to a subtle fade when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.
- **Props**:
  - `side` ("right" | "left" | "bottom" | "top", default: "right"): Screen edge from which the drawer slides in.
  - `open` (boolean): Controlled open state.
  - `defaultOpen` (boolean, default: false): Initial open state when used uncontrolled.
  - `onOpenChange` ((open: boolean) => void): Callback fired when the drawer opens or closes.
  - `title` (string, default: "Drawer Panel"): Heading title displayed in the drawer header.
  - `description` (string): Optional helper subtitle below the drawer heading.
  - `triggerLabel` (string, default: "Open Drawer"): Label for the default trigger button when no custom trigger is passed.
  - `trigger` (React.ReactNode): Custom trigger element that opens the drawer on click.
  - `children` (React.ReactNode): Custom content rendered inside the scrollable drawer body.
  - `footer` (React.ReactNode): Custom footer actions rendered at the bottom of the drawer.
  - `className` (string): Additional CSS classes applied to the drawer panel.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { Drawer } from "@/components/ui/drawer";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="flex gap-3">
      <Drawer
        side="right"
        title="Project Settings"
        description="Configure deployment environment variables."
        triggerLabel="Open Right Drawer"
      />
      <Drawer
        side="bottom"
        title="Quick Actions"
        description="Swipe down or press Escape to dismiss."
        triggerLabel="Open Bottom Sheet"
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

- **Slug**: `elastic-dock`

- **Tagline**: Continuous Euclidean pointer falloff and spring-tethered magnification.

  - Continuous Euclidean pointer distance interpolation with zero React re-renders during mouse movement.
  - Shared layoutId active indicator dot and floating HUD tooltips.
  - Full WAI-ARIA toolbar semantics with ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home, and End keyboard navigation.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Implements role='toolbar' with roving arrow-key focus management across all dock items.
  - Disables continuous magnification and vertical lift when prefers-reduced-motion is active.

  - `distance` (number, default: 140): Pointer proximity radius in pixels within which neighboring icons scale.
  - `stiffness` (number, default: 320): Hooke's Law spring stiffness coefficient for magnification interpolation.
  - `damping` (number, default: 22): Spring damping coefficient controlling oscillation settling.

  - `onSelect` ((item: ElasticDockItem) => void): Callback fired when a dock icon is selected

- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/elastic-snap-sortable.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Automatic FLIP layout projection via Framer Motion layout prop when rows swap positions.
  - Full keyboard reordering using ArrowUp and ArrowDown keys directly on focused list items.
  - Tactile up/down stepper triggers for single-click touch and pointer sorting.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Implements role='list' and role='listitem' with live position announcements in aria-label.
  - Supports ArrowUp and ArrowDown keyboard reordering without requiring pointer drag dexterity.
  - Snaps reordered rows instantaneously when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.
- **Props**:
  - `items` (SortableTaskItem[]): Initial array of task items containing id, title, and priority tag.
  - `stiffness` (number, default: 380): Spring stiffness coefficient for row swap layout projection.
  - `damping` (number, default: 26): Spring damping coefficient controlling row settle oscillation.
  - `onReorder` ((items: ElasticSortableItem[]) => void): Callback fired when items are reordered via drag-and-drop
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { ElasticSnapSortable } from "@/components/ui/elastic-snap-sortable";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <ElasticSnapSortable stiffness={380} damping={26} />
  );
}
```

### Elastic Wave Text (`ElasticWaveText`)
- **Slug**: `elastic-wave-text`
- **Category**: Text
- **Tagline**: Transverse sinusoidal wave propagation across headline glyphs.
- **Description**: Plucked-string kinetic typography that propagates a damped transverse wave across every character on hover or click.

- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/elastic-wave-text.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/elastic-wave-text.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Phase-delayed vertical oscillation that ripples sequentially from the first glyph to the last.
  - Secondary harmonic rebound (-0.45x crest) before settling at baseline.
  - Screen-reader safe sr-only canonical string paired with aria-hidden visual glyphs.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Exposes a single uninterrupted sr-only string for assistive technologies.
  - Operable as a focusable button via Enter or Space keys.
  - Suppresses transverse wave displacement when prefers-reduced-motion is active.
- **Props**:
  - `text` (string, default: "Harmonic Transverse Wave"): Headline string rendered along the transverse wave.
  - `amplitude` (number, default: -14): Peak vertical wave crest displacement in pixels.
  - `stiffness` (number, default: 420): Spring stiffness coefficient for glyph oscillation.
  - `damping` (number, default: 14): Damping coefficient controlling wave crest decay.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { ElasticWaveText } from "@/components/ui/elastic-wave-text";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <ElasticWaveText text="Harmonic Transverse Wave" amplitude={-14} />
  );
}
```

```tsx
          Spring Equinox
        </h1>
```

  - `damping` (number, default: 24): Spring damping coefficient for progress fill and recoil.

### Horizon Light (`HorizonLight`)
- **Slug**: `horizon-light`
- **Category**: Backgrounds
- **Tagline**: Planetary eclipse horizon & volumetric solar corona
- **Description**: WebGL planetary horizon limb shader with a razor-sharp incandescent core, volumetric FBM atmospheric corona, interactive solar apex tracking, and 8-bit dithered bloom.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/horizon-light
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/horizon-light.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/horizon-light.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Signed-distance planetary sphere (SDF) creating a crisp curved horizon limb
  - 4-octave Fractional Brownian Motion (FBM) polar god-rays radiating from the solar apex
  - Damped pointer tracking that gently shifts the solar apex along the curved arc
  - Supports both Eclipse Dark (#0c0c0b) and Architectural Bone Light (#f4f1ea) shader surfaces
  - High-frequency optical filmic dither to eliminate 8-bit gradient banding
- **Accessibility**:
  - Respects prefers-reduced-motion by freezing temporal ray animation
  - Canvas is marked aria-hidden so screen readers focus strictly on foreground content
- **Props**:
  - `primaryColor` (string, default: "#FF4D1C"): Primary atmospheric scatter color (International Vermilion by default).
  - `secondaryColor` (string, default: "#FF8A3D"): Inner solar corona glow color.
  - `deepColor` (string, default: "#6E1404"): Outer deep atmospheric bloom color.
  - `coreColor` (string, default: "#FFF3E0"): Razor-sharp incandescent planetary limb core color.
  - `horizonHeight` (number, default: 0.43): Vertical position of the planetary horizon apex (0.2 to 0.75).
  - `intensity` (number, default: 1.0): Multiplier for atmospheric bloom and limb brightness.
  - `speed` (number, default: 1.0): Animation speed multiplier for volumetric god-rays.
  - `interactive` (boolean, default: true): Whether pointer movement shifts the solar apex along the horizon curve.
  - `themeMode` ("dark" | "light" | "auto", default: "dark"): Selects dark eclipse mode, warm bone light mode, or syncs with page theme.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { HorizonLight } from "@/components/ui/HorizonLight";

export default function HeroSection() {
  return (
    <HorizonLight
      primaryColor="#FF4D1C"
      secondaryColor="#FF8A3D"
      deepColor="#6E1404"
      horizonHeight={0.43}
      intensity={1.0}
      themeMode="dark"
      className="min-h-[640px]"
    >
      <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col items-center justify-center px-6 text-center">
        <h1 className="text-4xl sm:text-6xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-white">
          Planetary Horizon Light
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-4 max-w-lg text-zinc-300">
          Volumetric atmospheric scatter and razor-sharp incandescent limb illumination.
        </p>
      </div>
    </HorizonLight>
  );
}
```

### Isometric City (`IsometricCity`)
- **Slug**: `isometric-city`
- **Category**: Backgrounds
- **Tagline**: Procedural isometric night metropolis with live avenue light streaks.
- **Description**: Procedural 3D-projected isometric night cityscape rendered on HTML5 Canvas 2D with depth-sorted skyscrapers, flickering office windows, rooftop aviation beacons, and avenue light-streak traffic.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/isometric-city
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/isometric-city.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/isometric-city.json
- **Key Features**:
  - True painter's-algorithm depth sorting across procedurally generated 3D isometric city blocks.
  - Hundreds of individual perspective-aligned office windows that subtly toggle on and off alongside rooftop aviation beacons.
  - Bi-directional headlight and taillight light-streaks gliding smoothly along the isometric avenue grid.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Canvas city projection is marked aria-hidden='true' to prevent screen reader noise.
  - Interactive palette, window-flicker, and city regeneration buttons support keyboard focus and clear state labels.
- **Props**:
  - `gridSize` (number, default: 7): Number of city blocks generated along each isometric axis (4 to 10).
  - `buildingDensity` (number, default: 0.78): Probability (0.3 to 1.0) that a grid parcel spawns a tower.
  - `trafficSpeed` (number, default: 1.0): Velocity multiplier for avenue headlight and taillight streaks.
  - `colorPalette` ("cyberpunk" | "midnight" | "amber", default: "midnight"): Color theme controlling sky gradient, facade shading, and window hues.
  - `windowFlicker` (boolean, default: true): Enables stochastic real-time toggling of individual office windows.
  - `children` (React.ReactNode): Optional foreground UI rendered above the cityscape.
  - `className` (string): Additional Tailwind CSS classes for the root container.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { IsometricCity } from "@/components/ui/IsometricCity";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <IsometricCity
      gridSize={7}
      buildingDensity={0.8}
      trafficSpeed={1.0}
      colorPalette="midnight"
      windowFlicker
    />
```

### Lava Lamp (`LavaLamp`)
- **Slug**: `lava-lamp`
- **Category**: Backgrounds
- **Tagline**: WebGL SDF metaballs with smooth-minimum liquid tension and 3D rim glow.
- **Description**: True WebGL signed distance field (SDF) metaball lava lamp shader using polynomial smooth-minimum (smin) surface tension blending, 3D specular/Fresnel subsurface rim lighting, and pointer thermal attraction.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/lava-lamp
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/lava-lamp.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/lava-lamp.json
- **Key Features**:
  - True polynomial smooth-minimum (`smin`) SDF blending with adjustable liquid surface tension.
  - Finite-difference 3D hemisphere normal reconstruction for glassy specular highlights and Fresnel rim glow.
  - Buoyant thermal wax cycle coupled with a gentle pointer heat attractor.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Marks the WebGL metaball canvas with `aria-hidden='true'`.
  - Interactive Magma, Cyber Acid, and Ultraviolet color presets are keyboard accessible.
  - Dark translucent HUD container preserves legible contrast over bright molten blobs.
- **Props**:
  - `blobCount` (number, default: 7): Number of buoyant wax metaballs inside the vessel (3 to 12).
  - `primaryColor` (string, default: "#FF3B00"): Core molten wax hex color.
  - `secondaryColor` (string, default: "#FFB800"): Subsurface Fresnel rim and thermal highlight hex color.
  - `backgroundColor` (string, default: "#0F071E"): Ambient vessel background hex color.
  - `speed` (number, default: 1.0): Thermal buoyancy convection speed multiplier.
  - `viscosity` (number, default: 0.45): Smooth-minimum (`smin`) surface tension blending factor (0.15 to 0.85).
  - `children` (React.ReactNode): Optional foreground UI rendered above the lava lamp shader.
  - `className` (string): Additional Tailwind CSS classes for the root container.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { LavaLamp } from "@/components/ui/lava-lamp";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <LavaLamp
      blobCount={7}
      primaryColor="#FF3B00"
      secondaryColor="#FFB800"
      backgroundColor="#0F071E"
      speed={1.0}
      viscosity={0.45}
    />
  );
}
```

- **Props**:
  - `strength` (number, default: 0.35): Multiplier controlling how strongly the button gravitates toward the pointer (0.1 to 1.0).
  - `stiffness` (number, default: 180): Spring stiffness coefficient controlling snap responsiveness.
  - `damping` (number, default: 15): Oscillation damping coefficient preventing excessive bounce on pointer exit.
  - `mass` (number, default: 0.2): Simulated physical mass of the button element.
  - `variant` ("primary" | "secondary" | "outline" | "glow", default: "primary"): Visual surface treatment preset.
  - `size` ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default: "md"): Padding, typography, and border-radius scale.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { MagneticButton } from "@/components/ui/magnetic-button";
import { Sparkles } from "lucide-react";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <MagneticButton variant="primary" size="lg" strength={0.4}>
      <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4" />
      <span>Deploy Kinetic UI</span>
    </MagneticButton>
  );
}
```

### Matrix Rain (`MatrixRain`)
- **Slug**: `matrix-rain`
- **Category**: Backgrounds
- **Tagline**: Incandescent phosphor glyph cascades with live character mutation.
- **Description**: Canvas 2D digital rain cascade with incandescent white leading glyphs, phosphor trail decay, and real-time character mutation across Katakana, Binary, and Hexadecimal character sets.

- **Key Features**:
  - Incandescent white lead glyph with bloom shadow and multi-step phosphor trail attenuation.
  - Switchable Katakana, Binary, and Hexadecimal character pools with stochastic mid-air glyph mutation.
  - DevicePixelRatio-aware ResizeObserver loop for razor-sharp monospace typography at any viewport size.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Decorative <canvas> is marked aria-hidden='true' so screen readers bypass background glyph streams.

  - `density` (number, default: 1.0): Multiplier controlling active column count across the viewport.
  - `charset` ("katakana" | "binary" | "hex", default: "katakana"): Glyph character pool rendered inside falling columns.
  - `fontSize` (number, default: 15): Monospace glyph size in pixels.
  - `children` (React.ReactNode): Optional foreground overlay content rendered above the rain canvas.
  - `className` (string): Additional Tailwind CSS classes for the root container.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { MatrixRain } from "@/components/ui/MatrixRain";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <MatrixRain color="#10B981" charset="katakana" speed={1.0} density={1.1}>
      <div className="flex min-h-[520px] items-center justify-center p-8">
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-emerald-500/30 bg-black/75 p-8 text-center backdrop-blur-md">
          <h2 className="font-mono text-3xl font-bold text-white">
            NEURAL UPLINK ACTIVE
          </h2>
          <p className="mt-2 font-mono text-sm text-emerald-400">
            Encrypted telemetry stream synchronized at 60Hz
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </MatrixRain>
  );
}
```

### Modal Popup (`ModalPopup`)
- **Slug**: `modal-popup`
- **Category**: Overlays
- **Tagline**: Spring-animated dialog popup with backdrop blur and keyboard support.
- **Description**: Animated popup modal dialog with spring scale transitions, top-level portal rendering, danger/confirm variants, and Escape dismissal.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/modal-popup
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/modal-popup.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/modal-popup.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Renders into document.body via React portal at z-[9999] with background scroll locking.
  - Supports sm, md, and lg width presets plus default and danger confirmation variants.
  - Works both controlled and uncontrolled with custom trigger and optional hideFooter.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Uses semantic role='dialog' and aria-modal='true'.
  - Dismisses immediately when pressing Escape or clicking outside the dialog.
  - Disables scale/translate motion when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.
- **Props**:
  - `open` (boolean): Controlled open state.
  - `defaultOpen` (boolean, default: false): Initial open state when used uncontrolled.
  - `onOpenChange` ((open: boolean) => void): Callback fired when the modal open state changes.
  - `title` (string, default: "Confirm Deployment"): Primary heading text inside the modal dialog.
  - `description` (string): Supporting description text below the title.
  - `size` ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default: "md"): Maximum width preset of the modal card.
  - `variant` ("default" | "danger", default: "default"): Visual style for the primary confirmation button.
  - `triggerLabel` (string, default: "Open Popup"): Label for the default trigger button.
  - `confirmLabel` (string, default: "Confirm"): Text label for the primary action button.
  - `cancelLabel` (string, default: "Cancel"): Text label for the cancel button.
  - `hideFooter` (boolean, default: false): Hides default Cancel/Confirm footer buttons when rendering a custom form.
  - `onConfirm` (() => void): Callback executed when the user clicks the confirm button.
  - `trigger` (React.ReactNode): Custom trigger element used to toggle modal open state
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { ModalPopup } from "@/components/ui/modal-popup";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <ModalPopup
      title="Publish Release v1.2"
      description="Are you sure you want to publish this release to the public registry?"
      triggerLabel="Publish Release"
      confirmLabel="Publish Now"
    />
  );
}
```

  - Duplicate prevention, max-tag counter, and filterable suggestion dropdown.

  - `allowCustomTags` (boolean, default: true): Allows users to create custom tags not present in suggestions.

- **Tagline**: Spotify-inspired media player with real-time reactive dancing waveform bars.
- **Description**: Spotify-style music player featuring dancing multi-octave equalizer frequency bars, spinning vinyl cover artwork, scrubbable progress bar with hover time tooltip, and playback controls.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/now-playing-waveform
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/now-playing-waveform.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/now-playing-waveform.json
- **Key Features**:
  - 32 reactive audio equalizer bars oscillating dynamically to simulate real-time audio playback.
  - Rotating vinyl sleeve simulation with dynamic track-specific background glow halos.
  - Scrubbable timeline with precision cursor hover tooltip and simulated playback progression.
  - Comprehensive media controls: Play/Pause, Next/Prev, Shuffle, and 3-state Repeat.
  - Quick track switcher allowing seamless preview of different music genres and color themes.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Full semantic button labeling with dynamic play/pause state communication.
  - Scrubber input accessible via click, drag, and standard volume sliders.
  - Equalizer animation gracefully responds to paused states without layout shifts.
- **Props**:
  - `tracks` (TrackItem[]): Array of music track objects with metadata, colors, and duration.
  - `initialPlaying` (boolean, default: true): Whether the audio playback visualizer starts in active playing state.

### Ocean Waves (`OceanWaves`)
- **Slug**: `ocean-waves`
- **Category**: Backgrounds
- **Tagline**: Multi-harmonic parallax ocean swells with subsurface glow.
- **Description**: Multi-layered rolling ocean waves rendered on Canvas 2D using multi-harmonic trochoidal wave equations, translucent subsurface ridge scattering, and shimmering crest foam highlights.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/ocean-waves
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/ocean-waves.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/ocean-waves.json
- **Key Features**:
  - 5+ stacked parallax wave layers computed via 3-harmonic sine and cosine superposition.
  - Translucent subsurface turquoise ridge glow with depth-graded ocean color attenuation.
  - Shimmering white crest foam lines and dynamic peak sparkles along breaking wave ridges.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Marks decorative wave canvas with `aria-hidden='true'`.
  - Maintains accessible contrast over dark abyssal gradients for hero typography and controls.
  - Interactive swell and foam controls are keyboard accessible.
- **Props**:
  - `waveCount` (number, default: 5): Number of stacked parallax ocean wave layers (3 to 9).
  - `amplitude` (number, default: 28): Peak vertical wave height in pixels.
  - `frequency` (number, default: 0.008): Horizontal wave frequency in radians per pixel.
  - `speed` (number, default: 1.0): Animation speed multiplier for wave propagation.
  - `oceanColor` (string, default: "#0284C7"): Base hex color used to compute subsurface crest and deep water gradients.
  - `foam` (boolean, default: true): Toggles shimmering white foam lines and peak sparkles along wave crests.
  - `children` (React.ReactNode): Optional foreground UI rendered above the ocean waves.
  - `className` (string): Additional Tailwind CSS classes for the container.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { OceanWaves } from "@/components/ui/ocean-waves";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <OceanWaves
      waveCount={5}
      amplitude={28}
      frequency={0.008}
      speed={1.0}
      oceanColor="#0284C7"
      foam
    />
  );
}
```

### Parallax Tilt Card (`ParallaxTiltCard`)
- **Slug**: `parallax-tilt-card`
- **Category**: Cards
- **Tagline**: Three-plane spatial parallax card with coupled 3D tilt.
- **Description**: Multi-depth 3D spatial card featuring three independent Z-planes that shift at graduated parallax ratios under pointer movement.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/parallax-tilt-card
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/parallax-tilt-card.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/parallax-tilt-card.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Three graduated parallax translation planes (±6px, ±16px, ±26px) coupled with ±14° 3D perspective rotation.
  - Driven entirely by Framer Motion useTransform and useSpring with zero React state re-renders.
  - Automatic spring return to neutral equilibrium on pointer leave.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Marks decorative background dot matrix planes with aria-hidden='true'.
  - Disables all 3D rotation and parallax plane displacement when prefers-reduced-motion is active.
  - Preserves semantic heading and paragraph hierarchy for screen readers.
- **Props**:
  - `title` (string, default: "Spatial Depth Plane"): Primary heading rendered on the foreground elevation plane.
  - `subtitle` (string, default: "Three independent Z-planes translate at graduated ratios..."): Supporting description text rendered below the title.
  - `maxTilt` (number, default: 14): Peak 3D tilt angle in degrees along X and Y axes.
  - `stiffness` (number, default: 240): Hooke's Law spring stiffness for tilt and plane parallax.
  - `damping` (number, default: 22): Spring damping coefficient controlling settle oscillation.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { ParallaxTiltCard } from "@/components/ui/parallax-tilt-card";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <ParallaxTiltCard
      title="Spatial Depth Plane"
      maxTilt={14}
      stiffness={240}
      damping={22}
    />
  );
}
```

### Particle Network (`ParticleNetwork`)
- **Slug**: `particle-network`
- **Category**: Backgrounds
- **Tagline**: Drifting nodes connected by distance-attenuated proximity lines.
- **Description**: Interactive Canvas 2D proximity graph where drifting nodes dynamically connect with distance-attenuated lines whenever they pass within a threshold radius.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/particle-network
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/particle-network.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/particle-network.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Computes pairwise Euclidean distance (`Math.hypot`) and renders edges with opacity proportional to `1 - dist / connectDistance`.
  - Interactive cursor node that links to nearby particles as the user moves their pointer.
  - Elastic boundary reflection keeps all nodes inside the responsive canvas.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Marks the `<canvas>` graph layer with `aria-hidden='true'`.
  - High-contrast foreground text over the `#05070B` canvas.
  - Zero pointer-event obstruction for foreground buttons and links.
- **Props**:
  - `particleCount` (number, default: 55): Number of autonomous drifting nodes.
  - `connectDistance` (number, default: 125): Maximum pixel distance at which two nodes form a connecting line.
  - `speed` (number, default: 1): Node drift speed multiplier.
  - `particleColor` (string, default: "255, 255, 255"): RGB triplet string ('R, G, B') used for node and line alpha rendering.
  - `interactive` (boolean, default: true): Connects nearby nodes to the user's cursor on hover.
  - `children` (React.ReactNode): Optional foreground content rendered above the network.
  - `className` (string): Additional Tailwind CSS classes for the container.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { ParticleNetwork } from "@/components/ui/particle-network";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <ParticleNetwork
      particleCount={55}
      connectDistance={125}
      interactive
    />
  );
}
```

  - 3D cylindrical `rotateX` perspective transforms with top and bottom fade masks.

  - Each column exposes `role='listbox'` with `ArrowUp` and `ArrowDown` keyboard support.
  - Individual items use `role='option'` and `aria-selected`.

```tsx
    <PickerWheel
      title="Schedule Deployment"

    />
  );
```

  - `open` (boolean): Controlled open state for the popover.
  - `onOpenChange` ((open: boolean) => void): Callback fired when the popover opens or closes.
  - `children` (React.ReactNode): Custom content rendered inside the popover body.

  - Each reaction button includes descriptive aria-label with emoji name and current vote count.
  - Full keyboard navigation through the quick bar and search picker popover.

- **Props**:

  - `authorName` (string, default: "Alexander Vance"): Name of the message author.
  - `authorRole` (string, default: "Staff Design Technologist"): Role or title of the message author.
  - `className` (string): Additional CSS classes to apply to the root container.
  - `inline` (boolean): Whether reaction bar is rendered inline with content or in popover
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx

  return (
    <ReactionPicker
      authorName="Sophia Nakamoto"
      authorRole="Core Protocol Engineer"

  );
```

  - `damping` (number): Spring damping coefficient

  - Chevron rotates with a snappy spring on open/close.
  - Menu flips above the trigger when there is not enough room below.
  - Supports primary, secondary, danger, and info visual variants.
  - Closes automatically on outside click and Escape.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Chevron trigger uses aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded to announce state.
  - Dropdown uses role="menu" with role="menuitem" items.
  - Arrow Up/Down, Home, and End move roving focus between enabled items.
  - Enter/Space selects the active item; Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger.
  - Tab closes the menu without trapping focus.
  - Respects prefers-reduced-motion by collapsing spring transitions to instant.
- **Props**:
  - `label` (string): Label for the primary (left) action button.
  - `options` (SplitButtonOption[]): Dropdown options revealed by the chevron trigger.
  - `onClick` (() => void): Callback invoked when the primary action button is pressed.
  - `size` ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default: "md"): Padding and typography scale of the split button.
  - `variant` ("primary" | "secondary" | "danger" | "info", default: "primary"): Visual style of both halves of the control.
  - `disabled` (boolean, default: false): Disables both the primary button and dropdown trigger.
  - `className` (string): Additional CSS classes applied to the root wrapper.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { SplitButton } from "@/components/ui/split-button";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <SplitButton
      label="Deploy Release"
      options={[
        { value: "preview", label: "Deploy Preview" },
        { value: "staging", label: "Promote to Staging" },
        { value: "rollback", label: "Rollback Production" },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

### Split Flap Text (`SplitFlapText`)
- **Slug**: `split-flap-text`
- **Category**: Text
- **Tagline**: Mechanical departure-board tiles with 3D rotateX spring hinges.
- **Description**: Mechanical departure-board split-flap display that cycles character tiles with staggered 3D rotateX spring hinges.

- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/split-flap-text.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/split-flap-text.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Individual character housing cells with a center mechanical split seam and 3D rotateX perspective flips.
  - Staggered per-tile wave delay creating an authentic Solari departure board cascade.
  - Click or press Enter/Space to cycle through an array of preset words.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Announces the active word via an sr-only role='status' live region while marking individual character cells aria-hidden='true'.
  - Board wrapper is a semantic button operable via Enter and Space keys.
  - Disables 3D rotateX flips when prefers-reduced-motion is active.
- **Props**:
  - `words` (string[], default: ["KINETIC", "PHYSICS", "SPRINGS", "MINIMAL"]): Array of words cycled on each split-flap board trigger.
  - `stiffness` (number, default: 380): Hooke's Law spring stiffness for 3D tile hinge rotation.
  - `damping` (number, default: 24): Spring damping coefficient controlling tile settle bounce.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx

  return (
    <SplitFlapText
      words={["KINETIC", "PHYSICS", "SPRINGS", "MINIMAL"]}
      stiffness={380}
      damping={24}
    />
  );
}
```

### Spotlight Card (`SpotlightCard`)
- **Slug**: `spotlight-card`
- **Category**: Cards

- **Key Features**:
  - Simultaneous radial surface illumination and 1px CSS mask-composite border reveal.
  - Zero React re-renders during pointer movement using Framer Motion useMotionTemplate.
  - Optional damped 3D perspective tilt along X and Y axes.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Decorative radial spotlight and border mask layers are marked aria-hidden='true'.
  - Automatically disables 3D perspective rotation when prefers-reduced-motion is active.

```tsx
  );
```

### Spring Pin Input (`SpringPinInput`)
- **Slug**: `spring-pin-input`
- **Category**: Inputs
- **Tagline**: Tactile OTP slots with spring bounce and staggered completion wave.
- **Description**: Tactile OTP verification code input with per-digit spring impulse bounce, staggered completion wave, and harmonic error shake.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/spring-pin-input
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/spring-pin-input.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/spring-pin-input.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Auto-advancing numeric slots with Hooke's Law vertical bounce on each keystroke.
  - Staggered completion wave across all slots when the final digit is entered, plus full clipboard paste support.
  - Damped horizontal harmonic shake when a non-numeric key is pressed.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Wraps slots in role='group' with individual aria-label='Digit X of N' attributes and inputMode='numeric'.
  - Supports Backspace auto-retreat, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight navigation, and multi-digit clipboard paste.
  - Disables vertical bounce and horizontal error shake when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.
- **Props**:
  - `length` (number, default: 6): Number of verification code character slots.
  - `defaultValue` (string, default: "482"): Initial digits pre-populated in the verification slots.
  - `stiffness` (number, default: 420): Spring stiffness coefficient for keystroke slot bounce.
  - `damping` (number, default: 22): Spring damping coefficient controlling slot oscillation decay.
  - `onComplete` ((pin: string) => void): Callback executed once all PIN code digits are filled
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { SpringPinInput } from "@/components/ui/spring-pin-input";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <SpringPinInput
      length={6}
      defaultValue="482"
      onComplete={(code) => console.log("Verified:", code)}
    />
  );
}
```

### Stepper Wizard (`Stepper`)
- **Slug**: `stepper`
- **Category**: Navigation
- **Tagline**: Multi-step progress wizard with spring connector and step transitions.
