- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/stepper.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Spring-animated progress bar connecting step nodes with checkmark completion states.
  - Directional slide transitions when moving forward or backward between steps.
  - Supports both controlled (`activeStep`, `onStepChange`) and uncontrolled (`defaultStep`) usage.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Marks the active step button with aria-current='step'.
  - Keyboard-focusable step indicators and navigation buttons.
  - Respects prefers-reduced-motion for step transitions and progress fills.
- **Props**:
  - `steps` (StepItem[]): Array of step objects ({ id, title, description, detail }).
  - `activeStep` (number): Controlled active step index (0-based).
  - `defaultStep` (number, default: 0): Initial active step index for uncontrolled mode.
  - `onStepChange` ((stepIndex: number) => void): Callback fired whenever the active step changes.
  - `onComplete` (() => void): Callback fired when the user completes the final step.
  - `allowStepClick` (boolean, default: true): Allows users to jump directly to a step by clicking its node.
  - `className` (string): Additional Tailwind CSS classes for the outer wizard container.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { Stepper } from "@/components/ui/stepper";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <Stepper
      onStepChange={(step) => console.log("Active step:", step)}
      onComplete={() => console.log("Wizard completed!")}
    />
  );
}
```

  - Dynamic rotational tilt and opacity stamps ('LIKE' / 'NOPE') mapped to drag offset.
  - Background cards dynamically scale up and lift forward as top cards are swiped away.
  - Tactile bottom action buttons (Rewind, Nope, Super Like, Like, Boost) with spring tap feedback.
  - Undo / Rewind stack tracking allowing users to bring back recently swiped cards.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Fully operable via standalone action buttons for keyboard and assistive tech users.
  - All action triggers include accessible ARIA labels with state feedback.
  - Gracefully operates with reduced motion settings enabled.
- **Props**:
  - `profiles` (ProfileCard[]): Array of profile items containing bio, metadata, tags, and visuals.
  - `onSwipe` ((card: ProfileCard, direction: "like" | "nope" | "superlike") => void): Callback invoked when a card is swiped or action button is pressed.
  - `className` (string): Optional custom CSS classes for the container wrapper.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { SwipeCards } from "@/components/ui/swipe-cards";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <SwipeCards
      onSwipe={(card, dir) => console.log(`Swiped ${dir} on ${card.name}`)}
    />
  );
}
```

### Toast Stack (`ToastStack`)
- **Slug**: `toast-stack`
- **Category**: Overlays
- **Tagline**: Viewport-positioned stacked notifications with hover fan-out.
- **Description**: Stacked viewport notification toasts supporting 6 viewport positions (top/bottom + left/center/right), hover fan-out, and auto-dismiss.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/toast-stack
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/toast-stack.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/toast-stack.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Supports 6 viewport positions: top-left, top-center, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-center, and bottom-right.
  - Renders in a top-level React portal (z-9999) with auto-dismiss that pauses on hover.
  - Expands smoothly into a full list when hovering over the stacked notifications.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Uses role='region' and aria-live='polite' so screen readers announce incoming toasts.
  - Each toast includes a keyboard-accessible dismiss button with aria-label.
  - Respects prefers-reduced-motion for entry and exit transitions.
- **Props**:
  - `position` ("top-left" | "top-center" | "top-right" | "bottom-left" | "bottom-center" | "bottom-right", default: "bottom-right"): Viewport placement where the toast stack is anchored.
  - `initialToasts` (ToastItem[], default: []): Initial array of toast notifications rendered in the stack.
  - `maxVisible` (number, default: 4): Maximum number of toasts visible in the stack at once.
  - `autoDismiss` (boolean, default: true): Automatically dismisses toasts after duration (pauses while hovering).
  - `duration` (number, default: 4500): Time in milliseconds before a toast auto-dismisses.
  - `viewportPortal` (boolean, default: true): Renders the toast stack into document.body at z-[9999].
  - `className` (string): Additional CSS classes applied to the control panel wrapper.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { ToastStack } from "@/components/ui/toast-stack";

  return (
    <ToastStack
      position="bottom-right"
      maxVisible={4}
      autoDismiss
      duration={4500}
    />
  );
}
```

### Variable Proximity Text (`VariableProximityText`)
- **Slug**: `variable-proximity-text`
- **Category**: Text
- **Tagline**: Real-time 2D Euclidean glyph lift and scale interpolation.
- **Description**: Interactive kinetic typography where each glyph interpolates vertical lift, scale, and contrast based on real-time 2D cursor proximity.

- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/variable-proximity-text.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/variable-proximity-text.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Per-glyph 2D Euclidean distance field driven by Framer Motion MotionValues without React state re-renders.
  - Word-aware wrapping that prevents mid-word line breaks on responsive viewports.
  - Screen-reader safe architecture pairing a single sr-only text node with aria-hidden visual spans.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Provides a single uninterrupted sr-only text string so screen readers never stutter over split characters.
  - Marks individual animated glyph spans with aria-hidden='true'.
  - Respects prefers-reduced-motion by locking glyphs at resting baseline and full contrast.
- **Props**:
  - `text` (string, default: "Kinetic typography engineered with spring physics."): The text string rendered as proximity-reactive glyphs.
  - `radius` (number, default: 120): Pointer influence radius in pixels around the cursor.
  - `maxLift` (number, default: -10): Peak vertical displacement in pixels at zero pointer distance.
  - `maxScale` (number, default: 1.22): Peak glyph scale factor at zero pointer distance.
  - `stiffness` (number, default: 300): Spring stiffness coefficient for glyph lift and scale.
  - `damping` (number, default: 22): Spring damping coefficient controlling glyph oscillation decay.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx

  return (
    <VariableProximityText
      text="Engineered with Hooke's Law spring physics."
      radius={120}
      maxLift={-10}
      maxScale={1.22}
    />
  );
}
```

### Warp Speed (`WarpSpeed`)
- **Slug**: `warp-speed`
- **Category**: Backgrounds
- **Tagline**: 3D hyperspace tunnel with warp jump and cursor vanishing point.
- **Description**: 3D hyperspace starfield using perspective projection (`screenX = x / z`, `screenY = y / z`), delta-time streak rendering, a cursor-following vanishing point, and a warp jump accelerator.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/warp-speed
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/warp-speed.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/warp-speed.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Projects `(x, y, z)` coordinates each frame using `x / z` perspective division and draws velocity streaks from the previous frame.
  - Smoothly ramps velocity 5x when `warp` mode is engaged.
  - Vanishing point smoothly tracks the user's pointer or locks to a custom `center` coordinate.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Marks the `<canvas>` layer with `aria-hidden='true'`.
  - Interactive 'Engage Warp Jump' toggle button is keyboard accessible.
  - Maintains high-contrast text legibility over the `#03050C` space canvas.
- **Props**:
  - `speed` (number, default: 180): Base forward Z-axis travel speed.
  - `starCount` (number, default: 320): Number of 3D stars inside the projection volume.
  - `streakLength` (number, default: 1.4): Length multiplier for each star's motion-blur streak.
  - `warp` (boolean, default: false): Ramps velocity up 5x for the hyperspace jump effect.
  - `center` ({ x: number; y: number }, default: { x: 0.5, y: 0.5 }): Normalized vanishing point coordinates (0 to 1).
  - `followCursor` (boolean, default: true): Steers the vanishing point toward the cursor on hover.
  - `children` (React.ReactNode): Optional foreground content rendered above the warp tunnel.
  - `className` (string): Additional Tailwind CSS classes for the container.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { WarpSpeed } from "@/components/ui/warp-speed";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <WarpSpeed
      speed={180}
      starCount={320}
      streakLength={1.4}
      followCursor
    />
  );
}
```

### Warp Text (`WarpText`)
- **Slug**: `warp-text`
- **Category**: Text
- **Tagline**: Cinematic spaceship hyperspace warp drive typography animation.
- **Description**: Cinematic sci-fi typography animation inspired by spaceship hyperspace jumps with directional motion blur, velocity scale stretch, and photonic light trail echoes.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/warp-text
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/warp-text.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/warp-text.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Cinematic directional acceleration supporting forward, left, right, up, and down warp trajectories.
  - Integrated motion blur, photonic glow bloom, and trailing ghost echoes.
  - Granular splitting control by character, word, or line with preserved whitespace boundaries.
  - Continuous velocity loop mode and interactive trigger options (mount, viewport, hover).
  - Screen-reader accessible: single accessible text label with aria-hidden animated tokens.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Includes sr-only complete text phrase so screen readers read the sentence smoothly rather than spelling out characters.
  - Fully respects prefers-reduced-motion by replacing high-speed blur/scaling with a gentle opacity fade.
  - Non-layout shifting transforms ensure zero Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
- **Props**:
  - `text` (string, default: "WARP SPEED"): Text content to animate through hyperspace warp.
  - `direction` ("forward" | "left" | "right" | "up" | "down", default: "forward"): Directional trajectory of the warp acceleration.
  - `speed` (number, default: 1): Speed multiplier for the warp acceleration.
  - `duration` (number, default: 1.1): Base animation duration in seconds.
  - `delay` (number, default: 0): Delay before the animation starts in seconds.
  - `blur` (boolean, default: true): Whether to apply directional motion blur during travel.
  - `glow` (boolean, default: true): Whether to render photonic bloom and glow highlights.
  - `trail` (boolean, default: true): Whether to render velocity motion trail echoes.
  - `loop` (boolean, default: false): Whether to cycle the warp animation continuously.
  - `trigger` ("mount" | "viewport" | "hover" | "manual", default: "mount"): Condition that triggers the warp jump animation.
  - `split` ("character" | "word" | "line", default: "character"): How text is partitioned for sequential stagger.
  - `glowColor` (string, default: "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.75)"): Custom glow accent color.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { WarpText } from "@/components/ui/WarpText";

export function HeroHeadline() {
  return (
    <WarpText
      text="HYPERSPACE ACTIVE"
      direction="forward"
      speed={1.4}
      blur={true}
      glow={true}
      trail={true}
      className="text-5xl font-black text-white"
    />
  );
}
```

### Water Ripples (`WaterRipples`)
- **Slug**: `water-ripples`
- **Category**: Backgrounds
- **Tagline**: Interactive 2D wave-equation height-map and specular ripple rings.
- **Description**: Interactive water surface ripple simulation combining a real-time 2D finite-difference wave-equation height-map buffer with expanding specular caustic refraction rings triggered by cursor wakes, clicks, and ambient droplets.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/water-ripples
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/water-ripples.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/water-ripples.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Real-time 2D finite-difference height-map solver computing surface normal refraction per pixel.
  - High-DPI concentric specular harmonic rings that expand and constructively interfere.
  - Responds to pointer wakes, click impacts, and toggleable periodic rain droplets.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Marks the simulation canvas with `aria-hidden='true'`.
  - Stop-propagates pointer events on HUD controls so slider adjustments do not trigger unwanted splashes.
  - Supports non-interactive ambient mode via `interactive={false}`.
- **Props**:
  - `damping` (number, default: 0.97): Wave energy retention multiplier per simulation step (0.90 to 0.995).
  - `rippleRadius` (number, default: 140): Maximum expansion radius in pixels for spawned concentric specular rings.
  - `ambientDrops` (boolean, default: true): Automatically drops periodic rain ripples onto the water surface.
  - `color` (string, default: "#38BDF8"): Hex color tint for refracted surface normals and specular caustic rings.
  - `interactive` (boolean, default: true): Enables pointer movement wakes and click splash disturbances.
  - `children` (React.ReactNode): Optional foreground UI rendered above the water surface.
  - `className` (string): Additional Tailwind CSS classes for the root container.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { WaterRipples } from "@/components/ui/water-ripples";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <WaterRipples
      damping={0.97}
      rippleRadius={140}
      ambientDrops
      color="#38BDF8"
      interactive
    />
  );
}
```

---

### Waterfall (`Waterfall`)
- **Slug**: `waterfall`
- **Category**: Backgrounds
- **Tagline**: Gravity-accelerated hydro streaks and volumetric plunge mist.
- **Description**: Physics-driven cascading waterfall background rendered on HTML5 Canvas 2D with 240+ layered vertical hydro streaks, gravity-accelerated splash droplets, and a pulsing volumetric mist cloud at the plunge basin.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/waterfall
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/waterfall.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/waterfall.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Three depth-sorted hydro streak layers with independent speed, thickness, and additive screen luminance.
  - Ballistic splash droplets launched upward from the plunge line with real-time gravity decay.
  - Pulsing volumetric mist puffs and shimmering water surface ripples along the basin floor.
- **Accessibility**:
  - Marks the decorative Canvas 2D element and vignette overlays with `aria-hidden='true'`.
  - High-contrast glassmorphic HUD controls remain keyboard accessible when no custom children are passed.
  - Automatically scales to devicePixelRatio (capped at 2x) via ResizeObserver without layout thrashing.
- **Props**:
  - `flow` (number, default: 1.0): Velocity multiplier for falling water streaks and splash kinetics.
  - `mistAmount` (number, default: 0.75): Opacity and density of the pulsing volumetric mist cloud at the plunge pool line (0 to 1).
  - `color` (string, default: "#38BDF8"): Primary hex color tint for the water streaks, subsurface glow, and mist.
  - `curtainWidth` (number, default: 0.75): Horizontal span of the waterfall curtain relative to the container width (0.3 to 1.0).
  - `splashIntensity` (number, default: 1.0): Spawn rate multiplier for upward-bouncing splash droplets at the plunge line.
  - `children` (React.ReactNode): Optional foreground UI rendered above the waterfall canvas.
  - `className` (string): Additional Tailwind CSS classes for the root container.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { Waterfall } from "@/components/ui/waterfall";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <Waterfall
      flow={1.15}
      mistAmount={0.8}
      color="#38BDF8"
      curtainWidth={0.75}
      splashIntensity={1.0}
    />
  );
}
```

### Wormhole Tunnel (`WormholeTunnel`)
- **Slug**: `wormhole-tunnel`
- **Category**: Backgrounds
- **Tagline**: Interactive Einstein-Rosen conduit with helical twist and spectrum shift.
- **Description**: Structured hyperspace wormhole tunnel on Canvas 2D featuring concentric polygonal energy rings and longitudinal warp ribs scaling from an interactive Lissajous vanishing point.
- **Docs URL**: https://boseui.site/components/wormhole-tunnel
- **shadcn CLI Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://boseui.site/r/wormhole-tunnel.json`
- **Registry Manifest**: https://boseui.site/r/wormhole-tunnel.json
- **Key Features**:
  - Exponential 3D perspective projection of concentric geodesic rings and longitudinal ribs
  - Pointer-reactive vanishing throat that smoothly falls back to an organic Lissajous oscillation
  - Continuous helical twist and spectral HSL hue shifting from throat to outer aperture
  - Interactive HUD with Cherenkov Cyan, Hyperdrive Magenta, and Chrono Gold presets
- **Accessibility**:
  - Canvas is marked aria-hidden so screen readers bypass decorative tunnel geometry
  - Interactive speed and twist sliders allow reducing motion velocity on demand
- **Props**:
  - `ringCount` (number, default: 28): Number of concentric depth rings rendered along the wormhole.
  - `speed` (number, default: 1.0): Forward traversal velocity multiplier.
  - `baseHue` (number, default: 195): Starting HSL hue angle in degrees (0-360).
  - `hueShift` (number, default: 90): Total hue shift across the depth of the tunnel.
  - `twist` (number, default: 1.2): Helical rotational twist factor along the tunnel axis.
  - `interactive` (boolean, default: true): Whether pointer movement bends the wormhole vanishing point.
  - `children` (React.ReactNode): Optional foreground UI rendered inside the wormhole container.
  - `className` (string): Additional CSS classes for the root container.
- **Usage Example**:
```tsx
import { WormholeTunnel } from "@/components/ui/WormholeTunnel";

export function WormholeTunnelDemo() {
  return (
    <WormholeTunnel
      ringCount={28}
      speed={1.0}
      baseHue={195}
      hueShift={90}
      twist={1.2}
      interactive
    />
  );
}
```
